title: Gambonanza modpack registry entry
description: One file per modpack under registry/modpacks/<id>.json. A modpack is somebody's whole setup: the registry mods they play with, plus the registry texture packs they wear, in precedence order. It has no repository, no release asset and no binary of its own - installing a pack installs each member through the exact same verified path as installing it alone. Members may be unreviewed submissions; the manager shows a warning icon on any pack that contains one, and names them before installing.

id.description: Unique, permanent, lowercase id. Must match the file name.

name.description: Display name shown in the mod manager.

author.description: Who curated the pack. Usually the GitHub username.

summary.description: One line, shown on the pack card. What is this pack FOR?

description.description: Optional longer text. Plain text or light markdown.

mods.description: Registry ids of the member mods, in suggested install order. Dependencies (like gambit-api) are pulled in automatically and do not need to be listed. May be empty when the pack is texture packs and nothing else - but a pack needs at least one of mods or texturepacks.

texturepacks.description: Registry texture-pack ids the setup wears, HIGHEST PRECEDENCE FIRST. Several can be on at once; where two change the same sprite or string, the earlier one in this list wins. Installing the modpack downloads and applies them all, in this order, alongside the mods.

homepage.description: Optional link with more about the pack.

submittedBy.description: GitHub login of whoever submitted the pack.

addedAt.description: Date the pack entered the registry, YYYY-MM-DD.
